source: Hand-traced from brochure-2bhk.png (Task 17): every door, window and passage of the flat, on the walls of brochure-2bhk.drawing-walls.json.

method.convention: As hdb-3room.drawing-openings.json: [u0, u1] source px along the wall from its node a; hinge start = u0; swing left = +n, n = (d.y, -d.x) (04 §2.1). A door's interval is the leaf's span, hinge jamb to closing jamb; a window's the break in the slate wall fill it occupies.
method.symbols: Walls are slate (about RGB 85 102 109) with dark outlines. Doors: quarter arcs (thin grey), the entrance's threshold drawn as a light band across the wall; the deck's folding doors as two pairs of slanted leaves stacked at its jambs. Windows: a white break in the wall with two thin frame lines (the large ones), or a neutral grey panel (about RGB 127 129 128) between black end lines inside the wall's outline.
method.profile_check: Every opening was read on 6-10x crops with a 10 px source grid and on RGB samples across the wall (the grey panels); the readings are in each opening's 'method'.
method.ignore: An opening marked ignore is ambiguous in the drawing: the metric neither counts it as missed nor counts a detection on it as false.
method.not_listed: The kitchen's open side toward the living room (x 152, y 215-245) is a passage, but no truth wall spans it (W24 ends at b13, W25 starts at b22): it has no host wall and is not scored.
